description: This PHP class serves as a data model for representing education entities within the OrangeHRM API framework. It uses traits for serialization and normalization, and is designed to be instantiated with an Education entity to facilitate API responses.

classes.name: EducationModel
classes.description: A model class representing the Education entity in the API response, supporting normalization and serialization.
